paragraphs: Genfare sells fare collection systems to public transit agencies, and describes itself as a partner to transit agencies of every size across the United States and Canada for more than forty years. Its systems cover fixed route service, microtransit, paratransit, ferries, and light rail.

The company is moving its Genfare Link platform to a fully cloud-based software-as-a-service model. Transaction, ridership, and device monitoring data from fareboxes, mobile apps, e-Fare portals, and retail channels are consolidated in one central location. For riders paying with a contactless bank card or phone, existing Fast Fare fareboxes can be upgraded for open payment, or an Open Link validator can be mounted next to the farebox. The Mobile Link application and the e-Fare online ticketing system use open APIs to work with microtransit and shared ride providers.

Genfare Link is built on Amazon Web Services, with APIs linking agency platforms to each other and to riders. Alongside the hardware and software, the company sells packages for training, maintenance and repair, and technical support.

quote.text: Genfare is the only fare collection provider that works with transit agencies of all sizes, whether your fleet has five buses or more than 500.
